info.title: Suno Music Generation API
info.description: Generate music using Suno AI models, supporting both vocal and instrumental modes

post.description:
- Suno AI music generation model, supports generating complete music based on text descriptions or lyrics
- Supports custom mode (fine control over style, title, lyrics) and simple mode (AI auto-generation)
- Supports [Persona](/en/api-manual/audio-series/suno/suno-persona-creation) for reusable vocal/style characteristics
- Asynchronous processing mode, use the returned task ID to [query status](/en/api-manual/task-management/get-task-detail)
- Generated audio links are valid for 72 hours, please save them promptly
- Each request generates multiple music variations

For Suno music tasks, `result_data` is an array of song objects. Each song includes `lyrics` (`string | null`) from saved provider result metadata and `actual_model` (`string | null`) from its actual engine identifier. Missing lyrics or an unknown/missing engine is `null`. Lyrics are not filled from the request description and are not guaranteed to match the sung audio verbatim or include timestamps. Query responses and terminal callback bodies use the same fields. Historical tasks expose these fields when the corresponding metadata was saved.

model.description:
Recommended models: `suno-v6`, `suno-v6-mini`, `suno-v6-wild` (their `-beta` aliases remain supported).

**Legacy compatibility names:** `suno-v4`, `suno-v4.5`, `suno-v4.5plus`, `suno-v5`, and `suno-v5.5`, with or without `-beta`, route to `suno-v6`. `suno-v4.5all` and `suno-v4.5all-beta` route to `suno-v6-mini`. These are EvoLink compatibility mappings; old names do not select retired engines or preserve their previous sound or duration. Validation, routing and billing use the target model; check the price for your user group.

New integrations should select a V6-family model explicitly. The response `model` preserves the requested name; each returned song reports `actual_model` from provider metadata, or `null` if unknown.

custom_mode.description:
Enable custom mode

**Description:**
- `false`: Simple mode, only provide `prompt`, AI auto-generates lyrics and style
- `true`: Custom mode, allows fine control over `style`, `title`, lyrics, etc.

**Required parameters in custom mode:**
- `style`: Required
- `title`: Required
- `prompt`: Required when `instrumental=false` (used as lyrics)

**Simple mode (`custom_mode=false`) supports only `prompt`:**
`style`, `title`, `negative_tags`, `vocal_gender`, `style_weight`, `weirdness_constraint`, `audio_weight`, `persona_id`, `persona_model`, `duration` are all unsupported in this mode. The API is not guaranteed to reject them, but they have no effect whatsoever on the generated result — use `custom_mode=true` if you need fine-grained control

instrumental.description:
Generate instrumental music (no vocals)

**Description:**
- `false`: Generate music with vocals
- `true`: Generate instrumental/background music without vocals

**Note:**
- In non-custom mode, this parameter doesn't affect required fields
- In custom mode, when set to `true`, `prompt` becomes optional

prompt.description: Music description or lyric input. In simple mode (`custom_mode=false`), required music description, maximum `3000` characters. In custom mode, required when `instrumental=false` and used as lyric input; optional for instrumental music, maximum `5000` characters. Legacy compatibility names use their V6-family target limits. Structure lyrics with tags such as `[Verse]` and `[Chorus]`; this is not a guarantee of verbatim singing.
prompt.example: A cheerful summer pop song about road trips and freedom

style.description: Music style, required in custom mode (`custom_mode=true`), maximum `1000` characters for V6-family targets, including legacy compatibility names. Use comma-separated style tags. In simple mode style is generated from `prompt`; this field has no effect.

title.description:
Song title

**Description:**
- Required in custom mode (`custom_mode=true`)
- Will be displayed in the player interface and filename
- Max length: `80` characters

Unsupported in simple mode (`custom_mode=false`): in that mode the title is generated automatically by the AI, so sending this parameter has no effect.

negative_tags.description:
Excluded styles, specify music styles or features to avoid

**Description:**
- Max length: `200` characters (same for all models)

**Examples:**
- `heavy metal, screaming, sad`
- `rap, fast tempo`

Supported only when `custom_mode=true`; sending it in simple mode has no effect.

vocal_gender.description:
Vocal gender preference

**Options:**
- `m`: Male voice
- `f`: Female voice

**Note:**
- Only effective when `custom_mode=true`
- This parameter only increases the probability, cannot guarantee the specified gender will be followed
- Unsupported in simple mode (`custom_mode=false`); sending it has no effect

style_weight.description:
Style weight, controls adherence to the specified style

**Range:** `0.0` ~ `1.0`, up to two decimal places and a multiple of `0.01`

**Description:**
- Higher values result in closer adherence to the specified style
- `0` is a valid value, means no adherence to the specified style, and is sent to the model

Supported only when `custom_mode=true`; sending it in simple mode has no effect.

weirdness_constraint.description:
Weirdness constraint, controls the creativity/experimental degree of the output

**Range:** `0.0` ~ `1.0`, up to two decimal places and a multiple of `0.01`

**Description:**
- Higher values result in more creative and experimental output
- Lower values result in more traditional and conservative output
- `0` is a valid value and is sent to the model

Supported only when `custom_mode=true`; sending it in simple mode has no effect.

audio_weight.description:
Audio weight, controls the weight of audio features

**Range:** `0.0` ~ `1.0`, up to two decimal places and a multiple of `0.01`

**Description:**
- `0` is a valid value and is sent to the model

Supported only when `custom_mode=true`; sending it in simple mode has no effect.

persona_id.description: Supported in custom mode by V6-family targets, including legacy names redirected to those targets. Obtain `persona_id` using the Suno Persona Creation API and read `result_data.persona_id` after completion. `persona_model` accepts `style_persona` or `voice_persona` and requires `persona_id`; it does not apply a persona on its own.

persona_model.description: Supported in custom mode by V6-family targets, including legacy names redirected to those targets. Obtain `persona_id` using the Suno Persona Creation API and read `result_data.persona_id` after completion. `persona_model` accepts `style_persona` or `voice_persona` and requires `persona_id`; it does not apply a persona on its own.

duration.description: Optional target duration in seconds, integer `10`–`360`, custom mode only. Supported by V6-family targets, including redirected legacy names. Best effort: tracks may be shorter or longer, and Mini may not follow the requested duration. When omitted, the model chooses the length. Billing is per generation, not by duration.

callback_url.description:
HTTPS callback URL for terminal task status

**Callback timing:**
- GroAPI sends one callback only when the task reaches a terminal state: `completed`, `failed`, or `cancelled`
- Upstream intermediate stages such as `text` and `first` are not forwarded
- The callback body matches the task detail structure returned by `GET /v1/tasks/{id}`

**Security restrictions:**
- HTTPS only
- Callbacks to internal IP addresses are prohibited
- URL length must not exceed `2048` characters

**Callback mechanism:**
- Per-attempt timeout: `10` seconds
- Up to `3` retries after the initial request fails
- A 2xx response is considered successful

id.description: Task ID, used to query task status and results

model.description: Requested model name, including a compatibility alias. This is not proof of the engine used; see each song’s `actual_model`.

can_cancel.description: Whether the task can be cancelled

user_group.description: Billing group the user belongs to

##All APIs require Bearer Token authentication##

**Get API Key:**

Visit [API Key Management Page](https://evolink.ai/dashboard/keys) to get your API Key

**Add to request header:**
```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```
